The '''Nym Protectorate''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. [[Nym's Stronghold]] was located in this region.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], the Nym Protectorate was one of many designated planetary regions.<ref name="SWG" /> The [[Star Wars video games|game]], developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
